description.text: Curriculum Courses of Politics and Foreign Language are exempted; Introduction to China and Modern Chinese Language mandatory is required; - Others courses are taken as the same as Chinese students. - The student who has completed the 4-year curriculum, passed the examinations and successfully defended the thesis will be issued a diploma and conferred with a Bachelor degree.

duration.text: The Marxist Philosophy at Jilin University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2638 USD/per year ￥ 19000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Undergraduate school transcript 5. Two Recommendation letters From Professors, associate professors or equivalents. 6. Certificate of HSK Band 6 or above (Not needed for English taught courses)

requirements.text: 1. With a bachelor's degree; 2. HSK band 6 or above.
